detailedTrainers.name: Marcus Vance
detailedTrainers.bio: Marcus is a former Olympic weightlifter with over 10 years of experience turning beginners into absolute beasts. His philosophy is rooted in mastering the basic compound movements before progressing to complex lifts.

detailedTrainers.name: Sarah Jenkins
detailedTrainers.bio: Sarah brings an infectious high-energy approach to every session. She specializes in pushing your cardiovascular limits and incinerating fat fast.
